art.style: Moody nighttime cityscape painting with photographic realism softened into painterly strokes. Near-black sky, dark charcoal and brown building masses punctuated by thousands of warm amber window lights, with occasional cool blue accents. Lighting comes from below and from windows, rims of warm gold on edges, deep shadows elsewhere.

notes: Plays like a standard three-platform stage on a wide rooftop: billboard catwalk and skylight canopy at 140, water tower lid at 280 for vertical play. Art priority: main-building, water-tower, fire-escape, billboard-catwalk, skylight-canopy, backdrop, escape-building, front-antenna, left-building.

art.style: Sun-bleached painterly realism with soft edges and heat haze: pale tan playa, warm ochre and rust sandstone, and a deep blue sky washing to near-white around a blazing sun. Hard midday light from the upper right, short cool blue-grey shadows, everything a little dusty.

notes: Vertical take: four levels stacked 130-140 apart (floor 0, boulders 130, arch shoulders 270, arch crown 410) so every step is one easy jump, but the crown sits high enough to make a strong king-of-the-hill perch and big blast top (1250) keeps vertical KOs fair. Dust Storm (every 25-40 s, 2.5 s warning with rising dust): strong leftward wind for 7 s, pushes recoveries and makes the left edge dangerous; dust veil and sagebrush lean sell it. Hawk Dive (every 20-32 s): the circling hawk shakes as a 2 s warning, then swoops down from the upper left through the middle tier (about y 150) and climbs off right, hitting anyone on the boulders or jumping. Art priority: 1) lakebed-mesa, 2) rock-arch (draws three platforms; keep ledge tops exact), 3) left/right boulders, 4) hawk-diver and hawk-circling, 5) dust-wall, 6) far-buttes, 7) sagebrush occluder. Curved arch underside is approximated with rectangles; the painter should round it.

notes: Play: two house rooftops (the eaves walks) are the safe main floor, split by a 340-wide sunken street that is permanently full of cursed fog (1% per half second). The fog also fills everything below roof level off the outer sides, so recovering from low costs damage. A broken porch beam just above the fog line is a risky foothold back up; the houses' inner ledges are grabbable for escape. Widow's walks (y140) and a tentacle-held plank (y210) give vertical play over the gap. Fog Surge (every 25-35s, 3s warning of rolling fog): fog rises almost to the roofs, the street zone throws fighters upward, and ledge-hangers get hurt. Art priority: left-house and right-house (they draw the main floors), street-and-beam, tentacle-plank, backdrop, front-fog, shadow-limb-art, surge-fog, gables, tentacles. Wanted but not buildable: sloped gable roofs to stand on (approximated by flat eaves walks and widow's walks).

art.style: Soft painterly watercolor with a subtle stepped, mosaic-pixel quality to every cloud edge, visible paper grain and wet pigment blooms. Palette of deep slate blue, dusty teal, mauve, ochre, honey gold and warm cream, lit by a glowing golden heart at the center of the nebula. Dreamy, calm and luminous, with glossy amber and blue paint beads floating everywhere.

notes: Vertical take: five tiers spaced 130 apart (floor 0, puddles 130, drifting bead 260, wisps 390, crown droplet 520) so every step is one easy jump, while the full climb is a big height difference; blast top raised to 1350 so high fights don't end too early. The center bead sways 60 each way and the crown droplet bobs gently to sell the 'slightly fluid' floor; those two use default blocks (theme colors blend in) since static art can't follow them. Paint gets everywhere: splats on every hit and big ones on KOs. Events: Pigment Rain (2 s flash + warning, two huge paint globs fall through the stage on fixed columns x -260 and 300, rain streaks), Nebula Drift (2.5 s warning, rightward wind over the whole stage with a brush-streak swirl and dust). Persistent paint stains on the floor and a truly sloshing/curved fluid floor aren't buildable yet. Art priority: 1 main-island, 2 backdrop, 3 the four puddle/wisp platforms, 4 drop-left/drop-right hazards, 5 cloud banks, 6 drift-swirl, 7 underwash and front-wisp.

name: Yo House
blurb: Swim through the fish tank, dodge the robot vacuum, and stretch before you stretch your lead.

layers.note: The far background, painted fresh from the concept.
layers.prompt: A long open-plan kitchen wall in cool morning light: a run of glossy white handleless upper and lower cabinets, a dark charcoal backsplash with under-cabinet strip lights, a sleek tap and a few bottles, tall paned windows at the far right with green garden leaves outside, and on the far left a glimpse through a wide doorway into a bright small yoga room with its own window. Blue-grey walls, white crown molding, recessed ceiling lights, dark wood floor receding into the distance, soft haze, no people.

art.style: Soft photoreal-meets-diorama interior rendering, like a dollhouse cutaway of a modern open-plan home. Cool blue-grey walls and daylight, dark glossy walnut floors, crisp white cabinetry, with the aquarium as the one glowing green jewel. Calm, airy and a little cheeky, as if the fighters are scrapping in someone's spotless living room.

notes: Play: a flat 1400-wide hardwood floor with the fish tank as a raised centerpiece. The cabinet stand (y120) is a solid block with ledges; above it the tank is a water zone where fighters swim slowly and stroke upward to the thin lid at y390, the stage's high ground. Left side is the yoga room (mat stack y130, shelf y260) and right side the sofa (seat y110, back y230), so the stage is deliberately asymmetric: tight vertical climbing on the left, a softer two-step on the right. Robo Vacuum (every 25-40 s, 2.5 s warning with blinking dock light and a beep): a hazard trundles in from off-screen left across the yoga room, bonks the tank stand and retreats, hitting anyone on the left floor. Bubbler Burst (every 20-35 s, 2 s warning with tank shake): an upward wind blasts through the tank, launching swimmers out the top for a lid scramble or edgeguard surprise. Art priority: 1 fish-tank (sets the whole look, keep water luminous), 2 hardwood-floor, 3 backdrop kitchen, 4 sofa and yoga-corner, 5 robo-vacuum-bot and bubble-column, 6 front-fern, exercise-ball, doorway, fish, dock. Not buildable yet: fighters breaking the tank glass, or a rolling exercise ball physics prop.
